info.name: Ehkam Laravel API
info.description:
Postman collection for ehkam-laravel-api.

Base URL default: http://ehkam-laravel-api.test/api

Notes:
- Most endpoints are currently public (no auth).
- Only /profile and /logout declare auth:api.
- Login currently returns role/info and does not issue a JWT.
- Some routed actions are missing in controllers (register/profile/logout/teachersReport/etc).
